text:
anna: Heads up — noticed a ~15% jump in model burn for tenant=zephyr during canary. Looks like our synthetic prefetches are landing in the model bucket and inflating the heatmap. Anyone seen this pattern? :confused:

mike: Yup. Telemetry tags those invocations as warmup but the aggregation step currently doesn't separate them. Heatmap queries use total_token_sum.

ash: UX ask: can we add a toggle in the heatmap to exclude warmup, and a small ‘Warmup estimate’ line in the rollout preview modal? Customers getting surprised during canaries.

oliver: Runtime note — we have two warmup paths: (A) KV/prefix prefetch and (B) synthetic probe calls to exercise the model. We can add header `x-rw-warmup: 1` and `x-warmup-group: <id>` on those flows to make attribution explicit. Cheap change.

jess: From billing/comms — we can’t silently credit customers. Warmup is billable by contract but showing it separately for visibility is fine. We can add an optional preview that shows an estimated warmup charge and a phasing note. If customers want protection, they can request a one-time warmup cap through support (manual today).

mike: Backend plan: split the metric pipeline into two rollups: model_tokens_total and model_tokens_user. Add model_warmup_tokens per-variant. Expose API param for console endpoints: `?include_warmup=true|false` and a preview endpoint `POST /v1/billing/preview` that accepts `warmup_cap_cents` (optional) for UI mock. We'll also add `warmup_sample_rate` to avoid telemetry spike.

ash: UI mock ideas: heatmap with hatched overlay for warmup. In rollout modal show a small gray bar labeled "Estimated warmup (prefetch + probes): $X/day" and a checkbox "Exclude warmup from dashboard metrics". Tooltip copy: "System-initiated warmup traffic performed when routing to cold variants. Billable but isolated for clarity."

mike: Quick SQL to preview warmup impact per variant (proto):
```sql
SELECT variant, sum(warmup_tokens) as warmup_tokens, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
  round((sum(warmup_tokens)::decimal / nullif(sum(total_tokens),0)) * 100,2) as pct_warmup
FROM invocation_tokens
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY variant
ORDER BY warmup_tokens desc;
```
Use this to populate the rollout preview panel.

oliver: Implementation detail: we'll sample synthetic probes at 10% and tag the sample with `warmup_sample=true`. For KV prefetches we can keep full emit but mark them separately. Need coordination on schema field names.

jess: Please add a clear line in billing docs: warmup is billable, shown separately; for enterprise we can discuss warmup credits in contracts. I'll prepare a short paragraph once copy is ready.

billing-bot: Created ticket RW-4982: "separate warmup telemetry + rollout preview" (assignee: unassigned)

anna: minor: can we surface warmup impact in the model-over-time sparkline hover? i.e., show baseline and baseline-excluding-warmup. Helps product managers.

mike: Good call. We'll add `model_cost_excluding_warmup` timeseries. ETA for backend + API: Wed EOD next week. Preview endpoint change in time for next rollout UI patch.

ash: I'll iterate the mock accordingly and add the figma link here when ready. Will also add small copy variants for the tooltip (short + long).

oliver: Runtime change target: Tuesday — header + warmup_group + sampling in a small PR. Will coordinate the schema change with mike.

jess: I'll loop in revenue to review tooltip and the paragraph for billing docs.

anna: great, thanks team. tagging RW-4982 for followups. :thumbsup:
